results.title: Das Theater im Sucher - Die Fotografin Ruth Walz
results.original_title: Das Theater im Sucher - Die Fotografin Ruth Walz
results.overview: For half a century, photographer Ruth Walz has been immersing herself in Europe’s theaters and opera houses, capturing the action on stage with passion and an unerring eye. Her theater photographs have set the standard for decades. In conversation with her colleagues, the unique stature and role of her photography are confirmed.

results.title: Part of Nature - Die Zukunft von Mensch und Natur
results.original_title: Part of Nature - Die Zukunft von Mensch und Natur
results.overview: An essayistic film about the very core of humanity: we are beings created to live with and on the Earth. Yet still, despite knowing better, we destroy the very foundations of our existence. The film accompanies protagonists from the fields of philosophy, agriculture and forestry, and architecture. Their work has the potential to initiate necessary processes of transformation. Their stories are placed in a broader context: the individual as part of the whole, connection and belonging.

results.title: Worst Superhero
results.overview: Over the past 20 years, the number of independent bookshops and comics stores has almost halved. The film tells the story of one of these rare places that is far more than just a shop. This documentary mixed-media portrait follows comic bookseller Naaman Wakim on a special journey. It explores the importance of places that bring people together, but also the adventure of leaving them behind.

results.title: Zeruya Shalev – Wie man Liebe schreibt im Krieg
results.original_title: Zeruya Shalev – Wie man Liebe schreibt im Krieg
results.overview: Zeruya Shalev is the voice of Israel. Her topics: family conflicts, love and pain. In the film, she tells her family story which is inextricably linked to the founding of Israel.

results.title: ZOKUZOKU: Uncanny Layouts
results.overview: In a house in an area known as “Old Sakaizuka”, a series of inexplicable incidents begins with the appearance of a room that should not even exist. Through property photographs, personal testimony, social media posts, livestream footage and an institutional investigation, five different records gradually reconstruct what happened there. Each perspective reveals another fragment, yet the more the events are documented, the less reliable reality becomes.

results.title: Raging Rooster
results.overview: At a garage sale, a man caught between the life he built and the life he left behind encounters a young music fan who unexpectedly reconnect him with his past.

results.title: Next Station
results.overview: As a solitary passenger rides the metro from one station to the next, the world above appears to slip from snow to rain, from day to night.

results.title: The Dog Whistle
results.overview: An obnoxious conservative politician is repeatedly pestered over the phone for an unknown reason

results.title: Dear Candidate,
results.overview: Uki, a Visual Communication Design fresh graduate who is still unemployed, suddenly receives an unexpected online job interview with no time to prepare. Living in a remote plantation area with poor signal, he must search for a stable connection while dealing with frustrating miscommunication with an impatient HR representative, all in hopes of passing the interview and securing a job.

results.title: Saira & David
results.overview: Saira and David are names rarely spoken now. To most, they are simply my parents, Devendrakumar and Sadhnaben. Their earlier names surface only in fragments before slipping away again.  Through this film, I follow their love story, shaped by faith, caste, and the quiet negotiations of everyday life. After their interfaith marriage, they built a life through shared labour and small acts of endurance.  As my elder brother approaches marriage, I return to their past, listening for what remains. In a society that defines love through marriage, I find myself questioning the space love occupies.

results.title: Dreams of a Sleeping Dragon
results.overview: For more than a year, people have been protesting every evening in front of the Georgian parliament against the autocratic regime of the ruling party »Georgian Dream«. A community without leadership, united by the hope for a future in Europe and the independence from Russia, but divided on how to get there. While the government tries to keep the protesters under control with police violence, heavy fines, and pressure on the judiciary, the protesters call out the names of political prisoners every evening. One of the demonstrators is the twelve-year-old Aguna, roaming the protest ground on his own. The story of a child whose childhood is taken away by adults – and who therefore declares himself an adult. A claim Aguna will not let anyone take away from him.

results.title: Non importa dove - La numerosa vita di Morgan
results.original_title: Non importa dove - La numerosa vita di Morgan

results.title: Geography Is Destiny
results.overview: The director returns to her homeland in a Bulgarian valley long shaped by the dichotomy of “Guns and Roses”: the harvest of roses that stretches across the landscape and the Arsenal weapons factory that employs much of the region. The film looks at labour—delving into the workforce that sustains this town, inexorably shaped by the current political context of migration and war—and at filmmaking within the working context. Echoing a tradition of direct engagement with labour, the director herself enters an unexpected and risky exchange of roles.

results.title: Son of Badriyah
results.overview: On their final day together, a boy and his great-aunt cling to small rituals together before an inevitable separation.

results.title: Wild is the Wind
results.overview: After years gone, Ana returns to her village due to the death of her father. Her intention is to leave after his funeral but she feels the need to stay, fueled by the intention of a power company to install a wind farm that divides the neighbors and affects her family’s land. Her participation in this conflict draws her back into the life of the community. A process in which Ana questions her sense of belonging, evokes a painful past and discovers a fighting spirit that she did not know she had.

results.title: Through the Cracks
results.overview: Plagued by a persistent rattling noise inside his head, a soon-to-be bridegroom desperately searches for its source and discovers an irrepressible truth.

results.title: Singapore God
results.overview: To get to work, a man sprints through a city where mundane panic and disaster collapse into one frozen moment.
